_metadata.description: Deterministic interview-driven scaffolding: PRD.md + requirements/ skeletons that validate clean by construction; resumable; dry-run by default.

requirements.title: Wizard questions derive from the validator's section model
requirements.description: The interview question model is generated from the same intent-go template-section definitions the validator checks, so wizard output and validator expectations can never disagree.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/wizard/questions_test.go. Asserts question set covers exactly the required section model.

requirements.title: Round-trip: wizard output validates clean
requirements.description: For a corpus of generated answer files, wizard output → validator yields zero REQUIRED findings (property test); a contract authored solely via --answers passes validate scenario clean.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/wizard/roundtrip_test.go. Property test over generated answer corpora.

requirements.title: Deterministic, offline, dry-run by default
requirements.description: No LLM or network calls anywhere in the wizard path; writes preview as diffs by default and only land with explicit --apply; sessions are resumable from a file under data/.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/wizard/wizard_test.go. Asserts no network seams are reachable from wizard; dry-run default; resume from session file.

requirements.title: Interactive and --answers modes
requirements.description: business-health wizard runs as an interactive TTY interview and non-interactively via --answers file.json, producing identical artifacts for equivalent inputs; init (registry-only scaffold) is the wizard's degenerate mode.

validation.notes: Planned ref: cli/domains/wizard/wizard_test.go. --answers mode exercised end-to-end; golden outputs; init subsumption covered.

requirements.title: Pre-scaffold capability dedup hook
requirements.description: When search-hub is reachable, the wizard surfaces 'similar capability exists in scenario X' before scaffolding; when it is down, the hook degrades silently with no impact on the interview.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/wizard/dedup_test.go. Hub-up returns results; hub-down degrades silently (fake client).
